sanitization.policy: Only declared personal/local identifiers are aliased. All fields, array lengths, verdicts, timestamps, durations, counts, errors, recovery actions, hashes and public source links remain. Process ID/birth/UID values become stable string aliases; all other non-string observation values retain their original type and value.
sanitization.scope: One alias table per category shared across the entire package. No reverse maps are published.
sanitization.stdout_handling: JSON-valued transport stdout is decoded to an object; all transport metadata is retained separately. Original file/encoded-stdout hashes bind its serialization.
sanitization.logs: Retained collected text is preserved with declared identifier substitutions. Guest-file hashes are reported observations, not hashes of normalized or sanitized text. Collected-text hashes and byte/line counts are recorded separately.
sanitization.source_scripts: Worker/operator/test source files are bound by original SHA256 and size. They are read for identity and selected static assertions, never imported or executed.
